summary.zh: 与 60 级野性方案完全相同的前 11 点：更省资源的技能、猎豹形态移动速度，20 级拿到野性冲锋。
summary.en: The same first eleven points as the level 60 Feral build: cheaper attacks, Cat Form speed, and Feral Charge at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，猎豹形态刷任务，难打的怪切熊形态
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, Cat Form questing with Bear Form for tough pulls

pros.zh: 凶暴从第一点起就让槌击、Primal Bite、挥击、爪击和扫击少消耗 5 点怒气或能量。
pros.en: Ferocity cuts 5 Rage or Energy from Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw and Rake from the very first point.

pros.zh: 豹之迅捷提供 30% 猎豹形态移动速度和 4% 躲闪，在 30 级之前顶替坐骑。
pros.en: Feral Swiftness adds 30% Cat Form movement speed and 4% dodge, which stands in for a mount before level 30.

pros.zh: 野性之心 3 点提供 6% 智力和 12% 熊形态耐力，20 级的野性冲锋则用来贴脸和打断。
pros.en: Heart of the Wild adds 6% Intellect and 12% Bear Form Stamina at three points, and Feral Charge at 20 closes gaps and interrupts casts.

pros.zh: 想变形时就带着资源？可以把野性冲锋与野性之心换成 4 点激怒。
pros.en: Feral Charge and Heart of the Wild can become four points of Furor if you would rather shift into a form with resources already banked.

pros.zh: 在地下城里同时拉住多个目标？把野性之心的点数移到野性本能，挥击伤害提高 30%。
pros.en: Holding several targets in dungeons? Move the Heart of the Wild points into Feral Instinct for 30% more Swipe damage.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
